info.title: CYCU-CAL Judge API
info.description:
C 語言教學與自動評測平台 API。

- 學生使用瀏覽器 session（HttpOnly cookie）；所有非 GET 請求需帶 `X-CSRF-Token`（由 `GET /api/v1/auth/me` 取得）。
- Agent / 腳本使用擁有者建立的 API token：`Authorization: Bearer ccal_…`，權限依 scope 限制。
- 錯誤一律為 RFC 9457 `application/problem+json`，欄位問題在 `errors[].pointer`（JSON Pointer）。
- 建立類請求可帶 `Idempotency-Key` 以安全重試。
- 詳細流程見 docs/api-guide.md。

get.summary: Who changed what (newest first).
All rules with their state, unpublished drafts and recent usage.
One custom rule: published value and unpublished draft.

put.summary:
Create or update a custom rule (draft). Its regex is checked against real
compiler output from the examples; custom rules are always shown as guesses.

delete.summary: Stage removal of a custom rule (applied on publish).
Discard an unpublished draft (rule or custom rule; use id `texts` for shared texts).

get.summary: Publish history (newest first). To roll back, PUT an older value as a draft and publish.

post.summary: See exactly what students would see, with drafts applied.

Publish every pending draft at once. Takes effect immediately for all
students, including when they re-open earlier submissions.

get.summary: One rule's built-in, published and draft wording.

put.summary:
Save a draft of a rule's wording. Templates are validated against the
variables the rule provides. Students see it only after publishing.

post.summary: Stage a revert to the built-in wording (applied on publish).

get.summary: Shared texts: confidence labels, notes, comparison-rule descriptions.

put.summary: Save a draft of the shared texts (full map).

get.summary: Cohorts (groups of students sharing settings).

post.summary: Create a cohort.

put.summary: Update a cohort's name, description and settings (applies immediately).

delete.summary: Delete a cohort (members keep their accounts, without a cohort).

get.summary: Export problems and sets as an import document (round-trips through `/admin/import`).

parameters.name: problem_set
parameters.description: Export one set (id or slug) and its problems; default: everything.

parameters.name: published
parameters.description: Use the published revision instead of the head revision.

post.summary: Import problems and sets from `cycu-cal.import/v1` JSON.
post.description:
- Items are matched by `slug`: identical content is a no-op, changed
  content creates a new revision, so retries never duplicate anything.
- All-or-nothing: the whole document is applied in one transaction.
- Everything imported stays **draft**: publishing and activating are
  separate, explicit calls.
- `?dry_run=true` validates and reports actions without writing.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Validate and report what would happen without writing anything.

422.description: problem+json; `errors` has JSON Pointers, `data` holds the full ImportReport

get.summary: Dashboard summary.
All problem sets, including drafts.

post.summary: Create a problem set (draft). Use `Idempotency-Key` for safe retries.

get.summary: One set with its ordered problems.

put.summary:
Update title, description, concepts, listing and (optionally) items.
The slug cannot change.

delete.summary: Archive a set (hidden from students). Problems are untouched.

put.summary: Replace the ordered list of problems in a set.

post.summary: Publish a set. Every problem in it must already be published.
Return a set to draft (hidden from students).

get.summary: List the problem bank.

post.summary: Create a problem (as a draft). Use `Idempotency-Key` for safe retries.

get.summary: Full problem including hidden tests and reference solution (head revision).

put.summary:
Replace the problem content. Creates a new immutable revision (unless
nothing changed). Published content is unaffected until you publish again.
Send `If-Match: <head revision number>` to avoid overwriting someone else's edit.

delete.summary:
Archive a problem. Refused while any problem set still includes it.
Revisions and submissions are kept for traceability.

post.summary:
Validate and publish a revision (default: head). Students get this
revision from now on; earlier submissions keep pointing at theirs.

get.summary: All revisions (newest first).
One immutable revision (including hidden tests).

post.summary:
Run any program against a revision's tests (including hidden ones) and
see full details. Useful while authoring.
Hide the problem from students (sets keep the reference).

Check that a revision is ready to publish (content rules + the reference
solution passes every test through the real judge). Changes nothing.

get.summary: Student × problem progress for one set.
Every leaderboard round, newest first.

post.summary:
End a round. Submits after this no longer count; a frozen board stays
frozen until revealed.
Freeze the board: students see results only up to now.
Reveal a frozen board to students.

get.summary: Current site settings.

put.summary:
Replace site settings. Applies immediately without a restart.
The rule that hidden tests are never shown to students is not configurable.

Make a published set the site's active (default) set. Takes effect
immediately; open editors are told about the switch and keep their code.
With `start_round`, the open leaderboard round ends and a new one starts.

get.summary: Which explanation rules students hit most (to prioritise teaching text).
All submissions (newest first).

Any submission with full detail (hidden tests, compiled source, judge errors)
and the exact problem revision it was judged against.
API tokens you created (secrets are never shown again).

post.summary:
Create an API token for an agent or script. Only an owner's browser
session can do this (tokens cannot mint tokens).

get.summary: List accounts.

post.summary: Create one account.

Create many students from pasted CSV text. All-or-nothing validation;
generated passwords are returned once.

get.summary: One account.

patch.summary: Rename, disable/enable, or move a user between cohorts.

put.summary:
Manually credit a problem as completed for a student. Judging results are
not modified; the credit is stored separately and can be removed.

get.summary: A student's overrides and resulting effective settings (with sources).

put.summary: Replace a student's overrides (unset fields fall back to cohort/site).

get.summary: One student's progress per problem, with common error types and hint use.

post.summary: Generate a new password for a user and sign them out everywhere.
Sign a user out of every session.
Log in with username and password; sets an HttpOnly session cookie.
End the current session.

get.summary: Current user, plus the CSRF token for cookie sessions.

post.summary: Change your password. All of your other sessions are signed out.

get.summary: Concept ids usable in `concepts` / `learned_concepts` fields.
Ranking of the round in progress.
Your autosaved draft for a problem (independent of problem sets).

put.summary: Save your draft. Returns 409 with the stored draft if it changed elsewhere.

get.summary: Your progress over all problems in sets visible to you.
Your submission history (newest first).
Published problem sets visible to you.
One published problem set with its problems (in order) and your progress.

A published problem: statement, examples, starter code and public tests.
Hidden tests and the reference solution are never included.
Rounds you can view, newest first.
Ranking of one round, open or ended.
Site name, announcement and which problem set to open by default.

post.summary:
Queue a Run or Submit. Returns immediately (202); poll the submission.
Send an `Idempotency-Key` header to make retries safe.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Reusing a key returns the original submission instead of creating a new one

get.summary:
Status, test results and teaching cards. Poll until `status` is `done`
or `system_error`. Hidden tests show only their verdict.

post.summary: Reveal the next hint level for one card (recorded for teaching statistics).

Re-queue a submission that failed because of the judging service.
It is judged against the same problem revision as before.

get.summary: Health of the judging service, for the status banner.

round_id.description: The round started by this request, if any.

problem_set.description: Id or slug of a published set.

oneOf.description: Also end the open leaderboard round and start a new one on this set.

active.description: This set is the site's active (default) set.

kind.description: `first_solve` or `no_hints`; more kinds may be added.

csv.description: One student per line: `username,display name`. Lines starting with `#` are ignored.

hints_allowed.description: How many hints this student may reveal in total (policy).

pending_changes.description: Number of entries with unpublished changes.

minutes.description: Minutes from the round start to the first accept.

pending.description: Submits made after the freeze whose results are hidden.

wrong_tries.description:
Wrong submits (compile errors excluded) before the first accept, or
in total when unsolved.

blanks.description:
Fill-in problems only: blank id → your code. Fixed code always comes
from the server's copy of the template.

set_id.description: The set you were working in (used for wording and statistics).

stdin.description: `run` only: use this as stdin instead of the public tests.

expires_in_days.description: Days until expiry (1–365). Omit for no expiry.

scopes.description: Least privilege: grant only what the agent needs.

oneOf.description: Defaults to `student`. Creating owners requires an owner session.

token.description: The secret. Shown only once; store it securely. Use as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

initial_password.description: Only present when the password was generated; shown once.

published.description: Version students currently get (absent if never published).

negative_examples.description: Programs that must NOT be matched by this rule.

positive_examples.description:
Programs that must produce a diagnostic matched by this rule
(compiled with the real toolchain). At least one is required.

matched_messages.description: For each positive example: the compiler message that matched.

actual_line.description: 1-based line number in the actual output (for Same/Extra).

expected_line.description: 1-based line number in the expected output (for Same/Missing).

text.description:
Line content with whitespace made visible: space → `·`, tab → `→`,
and a trailing `↵` when the line ended with a newline.

version.description: Increments on every save; send it back as `base_version`.

learned_concepts.description: Union of site, cohort and student concepts (problem/set concepts are added per request).

pointer.description: JSON Pointer (RFC 6901) to the offending field, relative to the request body.

published.description: The published value (null = reverted to built-in / removed).

pointer.description: JSON Pointer of the item in the document.

ok.description: True when the document is valid (and, unless dry-run, was applied).

learned_concepts.description: Concepts students are assumed to know in this set.

listed.description: Unlisted sets are only visible to cohorts/students granted access.

problems.description: Problem slugs in display order (from this document or already in the bank).

Problem ids or slugs in display order. Problems not listed are removed
from this set only.

frozen.description: Results after `round.frozen_at` are hidden from this viewer.

rows.description: Only students who submitted during the round, best first.

cells.description: One entry per problem (same order): `solved`, `credited`, `attempted` or `not_started`.

csrf_token.description: Send as `X-CSRF-Token` on every non-GET request made with the session cookie.

token_scopes.description: Present when authenticated with an API token.

password.description: Shown once. The user must change it at next login.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; absent on the last page.
Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; absent on the last page.
Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; absent on the last page.
Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; absent on the last page.
Pass as `cursor` to get the next page; absent on the last page.

PolicyPatch.description: Every field is optional; unset fields fall through to the next level.

auto_reveal_hints.description: Hint levels shown without clicking (0 = only the card).

default_set_id.description: Set shown on entry instead of the site's active set.

extra_set_ids.description: Additional sets (including unlisted ones) visible at this level.

leaderboard.description: Show the leaderboard and list this student on it.

learned_concepts.description: Concepts added at this level (union with other levels).

max_hint_levels.description: Maximum hint levels a student may reveal (`None` = all).

raw_expanded.description: Expand the original compiler message by default.

visible_set_ids.description: Restrict visible published sets to these (cohort level). `None` = all listed sets.

effective.description: Resulting values with the level each one came from.

concepts.description: Pretend the student has learned these concepts.

source.description: Compile this program with the real toolchain and explain it.

submission_id.description: Or re-explain an existing submission (student identity is not shown).

cards.description: Every card with all hint levels.

ProblemContent.description: Everything that defines one revision of a problem.

concepts.description: Concepts students are assumed to know for this problem.

reference_solution.description: Owner-only reference program (mode `full`); must pass every test to publish.

has_unpublished_changes.description: The head revision differs from the published one.

published_revision_number.description: Revision students currently get (None if never published).

revision_created.description: Only on writes: whether a new revision was created (false = no change).

data.description: Extra structured data for some errors (e.g. the current draft on conflict).

errors.description: Field-level problems (JSON Pointers into the request body).

type.description: URI identifying the error type (`about:blank` style codes under /errors/).

initial_code.description: Editor content to start from (full program, or the assembled template).

revision_number.description: The published revision number students currently get.

segments.description: Fill-in only: template segments; only `blank` segments are editable.

submission_count.description: Student runs/submissions judged against this revision (owner test runs excluded).

frozen_at.description: While set, students see the board as of this moment.

reset_pending.description: Publishing will revert this rule to the built-in wording.

hits_7d.description: Submissions in the last 7 days that hit this rule.

vars.description: Variables available in this rule's templates.

count.description: Submissions that triggered the rule in the period.

hints_revealed.description: Hint levels revealed on cards of this rule.

base_version.description: The version you last loaded/saved. Omit to overwrite unconditionally.

Scope.description: Least-privilege permissions for API tokens. Owner sessions hold all of them.

problems.description: Problem ids or slugs, in order. Optional on create.

active.description: This is the site's currently active set.

active_set_id.description: The owner-selected active set (the default entry point).

config_version.description: Bumps whenever online settings change; clients poll it to detect switches.

default_set_id.description: The set this user should land on (cohort/student settings may differ).

open_round_id.description: The leaderboard round in progress, if any.

announcement_md.description: Markdown shown on the student home page (rendered without raw HTML).

default_policy.description: Site-level policy (lowest precedence; cohorts and students override it).

penalty.description: Minutes: time to each accept plus `PENALTY_PER_WRONG` per wrong try.

rank.description: 1-based; rows tied on solved, penalty and last accept share a rank.

assembled_source.description: Owner only: the exact program that was compiled and judge diagnostics.

raw_expanded.description: Policy: expand original compiler messages by default.

retryable.description: The judging service failed; the student may ask for a re-judge.

revision_number.description: The immutable problem revision this submission was judged against.

stdin.description: Use this stdin instead of the tests.

use_reference.description: Run the stored reference solution instead of `code`/`blanks`.

diff.description: Line diff with visible whitespace (public tests that failed).

cohort_id.description: Set to move the student; send `"clear_cohort": true` to remove.

frequent_rules.description: Rules most often hit by this student on this problem.

ok.description: True when the revision can be published.

oneOf.description: Result of running the reference solution against every test.
